metadata.ffmpeg_version: 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev built with gcc 14.2.0 (Rev1, Built by MSYS2 project)

scan.note: Technical signals only. Continuous visual review and user approval remain separate.

scope: First-look same-outfit two-shot technical/editorial sub-sequence only, not formal one-model/two-look Reel delivery.
editing: Original24fps source speed, tail trim only, no text/audio/crop/zoom/freeze/speed effects.

visual_review.method: All132 output thumbnails,25 larger whole-frame samples,5 face samples;23 transition/boundary samples including all18 dissolve frames.
visual_review.findings: No black/decode failures; recognizable clothing and face in sampled single-source intervals. Standing-to-seated scale, face position and bench viewpoint differ; visible double heads/body outlines during overlap. Not an invisible match.
visual_review.limits: No assistant continuous normal-speed playback. User comfort, daily-magazine impression, originality and whole-film acceptance pending. No audience or sustainable-budget conclusions.

editorial_direction_acceptance.context: Direct reply after showing5.5s same-outfit A1→A2 trial and asking whether it approaches an approachable everyday magazine.
editorial_direction_acceptance.scope: Editorial direction accepted; continue second look within existing storyboard. Not final full-Reel approval, account-wide template adoption, audience success or a self-report of uninterrupted playback.
